title: Upgrade a Helm Release
prompt:
The Helm release `cka-web` runs in namespace `cka-helm` from the local chart `assets/helm-chart` (revision 1, image nginx:1.26-alpine, 1 replica).

Perform the following tasks:
1. Upgrade the release `cka-web` to the image `nginx:1.27-alpine`.
2. Scale the release to `2` replicas.
3. Keep the release name and chart path unchanged.

checks.failure_hint: Run helm upgrade so the revision increments.

checks.description: Two Pods of the release are Ready

commands: helm upgrade cka-web assets/helm-chart -n cka-helm --set image.tag=1.27-alpine --set replicaCount=2

reference_solution:
Upgrade with the new image tag and replica count.
```bash
helm upgrade cka-web assets/helm-chart -n cka-helm \
  --set image.tag=1.27-alpine --set replicaCount=2
```
hints: List existing releases with `helm list -n cka-helm` and inspect chart values under `assets/helm-chart`.
Use `helm upgrade cka-web assets/helm-chart -n cka-helm` overriding `image.tag` and `replicaCount`.
fast_solution_commands: helm upgrade cka-web assets/helm-chart -n cka-helm --set image.tag=1.27-alpine --set replicaCount=2
